command:
set +e
cd "$ASTRID_RUNTIME_CHECKOUT"
mkdir -p r07-cp3-evidence
python -m pip install -e '.[test]' > r07-cp3-evidence/install.log 2>&1
install_code=$?
printf '%s\n' "$install_code" > r07-cp3-evidence/install.exit
python -m pytest --collect-only -q tests/test_contract_fixtures.py tests/test_update_jobs.py > r07-cp3-evidence/collect.log 2>&1
collect_code=$?
printf '%s\n' "$collect_code" > r07-cp3-evidence/collect.exit
python -m pytest -q tests/test_contract_fixtures.py tests/test_update_jobs.py > r07-cp3-evidence/test.log 2>&1
test_code=$?
printf '%s\n' "$test_code" > r07-cp3-evidence/test.exit
cat r07-cp3-evidence/install.log
cat r07-cp3-evidence/collect.log
cat r07-cp3-evidence/test.log
if [ "$install_code" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$install_code"; fi
if [ "$collect_code" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$collect_code"; fi
exit "$test_code"
